text.text:
**Review for 7-ELEVEN 動物園門市**

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The 7-ELEVEN at 動物園門市 is a fantastic convenience store that perfectly complements a visit to the Taipei Zoo. Here’s my detailed review:

**Location and Accessibility:**
Conveniently located right next to the Taipei Zoo, this 7-ELEVEN is easy to find and provides a perfect stop for snacks and supplies before or after your zoo visit. The proximity to the MRT station and bus stops makes it easily accessible for both locals and tourists.

**Store Layout and Cleanliness:**
The store is clean, well-organized, and easy to navigate. Shelves are neatly stocked, and the layout is intuitive, making it simple to find what you need. The bright lighting and tidy aisles create a pleasant shopping environment, which is always appreciated when you’re on the go.

**Product Variety:**
As with other 7-ELEVEN locations, this store offers a wide variety of products. From fresh food and beverages to snacks, toiletries, and everyday essentials, you can find almost everything you need. The selection of local snacks and drinks is particularly noteworthy, providing a taste of Taiwan’s unique flavors.

**Food and Beverages:**
The ready-to-eat food options are excellent. Fresh bento boxes, sandwiches, onigiri, and hot snacks are always available and of high quality. The coffee and beverage section is also well-stocked, offering a range of options to refresh and energize you during your visit.

**Service:**
The staff at 7-ELEVEN 動物園門市 are friendly and efficient. They handle transactions quickly and are always ready to assist with any questions or needs. Their professionalism and helpful attitude enhance the overall shopping experience.

**Additional Services:**
This 7-ELEVEN location offers several convenient services, such as ATM access, bill payment, and mobile top-ups. These additional amenities make it a one-stop-shop for more than just groceries, adding to its overall convenience.

**Overall Experience:**
My experience at 7-ELEVEN 動物園門市 has always been positive. The store’s strategic location, combined with its wide product range, cleanliness, and excellent service, make it a standout convenience store. Whether you’re preparing for a day at the zoo or just passing by, this 7-ELEVEN is a reliable and convenient stop. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the Taipei Zoo area!

text.text: Convenience store right at the entrance to Taipei Zoo so you can refuel for the trip or after finishing the tour with lots of food, snacks, and drinks. The space is a bit small. On weekends, there are a lot of customers, but luckily the staff handles the job very quickly.

text.text: They have almost zero vegetarian or vegan choices. Even their egg sandwiches have pork in them but it only says egg in English and the pork is written in Mandarin. Its like they are trying to cheat English speakers. It’s the WORST 7-Eleven I have ever been to. Only meat things to eat and they charge you for chopsticks for the food you purchase. I expected better. I do NOT recommend this store inside the zoo. The zoo should do better.

text.text: I don't know why it surprised me as these shops are absolutely everywhere in Taipei, but I was surprised nevertheless that there was a seven eleven inside the zoo.  But i have to say it was pretty handy as I got a few drinks from here as well as a nice Pokémon doughnut one day for my breakfast!
